scenes.setting: Chanis Gate handover: Maynard died last night — Klein is only 'providing assistance'; Dunn takes the guard shift
scenes.text_anchor: How long has the Member of Parliament been dead for?

scenes.setting: New two-star inspector uniform, then the reception hall: reunion with the bear-like Inspector Tolle and clown-combination banter
scenes.text_anchor: Klein walked upstairs, but he wasn't in a hurry

scenes.setting: Police carriage briefing: Maynard found naked in a guest room after a party; his party-leader wife is racing back from Backlund
scenes.text_anchor: They casually chatted until they got onto the police carriage.

scenes.setting: Maynard's Golden Indus bungalow: past the streamers and statement-taking, up to the crimson guest-room door
scenes.text_anchor: Klein put on his peak hat with its police badge

scenes.setting: The locked guest room (visions only: Maynard's final tryst with an ageless delicate woman): the ritual yields her portrait — then the corpse clears its throat and sits up
scenes.text_anchor: He walked to the side of the bed and saw that the crimson bedsheets were abnormally messy.
